facts.about: Tata Consultancy Services is the flagship company and a part of Tata group. It is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world's largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 101% of PAT

business.summary: Tata Consultancy Services Limited provides IT services, consulting, and business solutions to global enterprises, making money through application development, maintenance, digital transformation, cloud services, and cognitive business operations.

guidance.statement: We will endeavor to inch up on our margins while prioritizing investments.
guidance.quote: While it's an uphill task, we'll continue to endeavor to inch up on our margins.

guidance.statement: Exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.
guidance.quote: We want to exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.

guidance.statement: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.
guidance.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.

guidance.statement: We expect the ongoing labor code impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.
guidance.quote: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.

guidance.statement: On the labor code we don't expect any incremental one-off's.
guidance.quote: On the labor code we don't expect any incremental one-off's.

scorecard.promised: Exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margins stood at 24% in the most recent quarter.
scorecard.evidence: Margins fell from 26% in June 2026 to 24% in September 2026, missing the 25% plus target.

scorecard.promised: Move towards 26% on a longer-term basis.
scorecard.delivered: Current operating margin is 24% as of September 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Management now describes inching up margins as an uphill task while prioritizing investments.

scorecard.promised: Expect ongoing labor code impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.
scorecard.delivered: No incremental one-offs reported in subsequent quarters.
scorecard.evidence: Margins remained stable at 25.2% excluding one-offs in the quarter following the guidance.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully scaled AI revenue but is struggling to defend the 25% margin floor amid investment priorities.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Operating margins remained stable sequentially at 24% as we prioritized growth investments.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margins are down significantly from the 27% levels seen throughout FY2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of overall revenue.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: AI revenue has scaled rapidly from $1.8 billion in December 2025 to $3.1 billion.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: LTM attrition in IT services reduced by 30 basis points sequentially to 13.3%.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Attrition has trended down from 13.5% in December 2025 to 13.3% in September 2026.

bull: AI revenue shows explosive growth, reaching $3.1 billion and representing over 10% of total revenue.
Strong cash generation with five-year operating cash flow at 101% of net profit.
Order book remains robust with a TCV of $9.5 billion in the June 2026 quarter.
bear: Operating margins have slipped to 24%, well below the long-term 26% target and previous 27% highs.
Management admits that increasing margins is now an uphill task due to necessary growth investments.
Cash conversion cycle has deteriorated to 93 days from 81 days three years ago.
watch: Margin recovery toward 25% exit target without further wage hike impacts.
